name: Ammonia as hydrogen carrier and ammonia cracking
applications: import terminals receiving green or blue ammonia
hydrogen supply for power and industry in importing countries such as Japan and Korea
principle: Hydrogen is shipped as liquid ammonia, which is easy to store and already traded worldwide. At the destination, ammonia is heated over a catalyst and decomposed into hydrogen and nitrogen in an endothermic reaction, then hydrogen is purified and residual ammonia removed. Part of the product or ammonia is burned to supply reaction heat.

process_steps.name: Catalytic cracking
equipment: fired cracking furnace with catalyst tubes or reactor

process_steps.name: Cooling and ammonia removal
equipment: ammonia absorber or recovery with recycle

performance.basis: vendor claim; ammonia slip below 0.1 ppmv; KBR also claims 90% efficiency without stating the basis

source.note: KBR H2ACT technology page, read 24 October 2026

reference_plants.name: SUSO ammonia cracking project, Ulsan
reference_plants.capacity: 10 t/day hydrogen from 72 t/day ammonia (KBR H2ACT)

source.note: KBR H2ACT technology page, read 24 October 2026

advantages: Ammonia shipping and storage infrastructure already exists
Higher volumetric hydrogen density than liquid hydrogen
Ammonia can also be used directly as fuel without cracking
limitations: Cracking needs high-temperature heat, which costs part of the delivered energy
Ammonia is toxic and needs strict handling
Few cracking plants yet at commercial scale
